Maria Lopez.description: conversing about a medical consultation between Maria Lopez and Klaus Mueller regarding neurological symptoms that led to a diagnosis of Myasthenia Gravis @ <persona> Klaus Mueller
chat:
Doctor: When did your symptoms first start, and has there been any worsening or improvement over time?  
Doctor: Have you experienced any numbness, tingling, or loss of sensation in your body?  
Doctor: Do you have any difficulty speaking, swallowing, or changes in your vision besides double vision?  
Doctor: Have you had recent infections, trauma, or exposure to toxins?  
Doctor: Do you have a history of autoimmune disorders, such as multiple sclerosis?  
Doctor: Are there any associated symptoms like fatigue, fever, or weight loss?  
Doctor: Do you have any other neurological symptoms like balance problems or coordination issues?  
Doctor: Could you describe the exact nature of your upper limb weakness—does it affect both arms equally or only one side?  
Doctor: Have you had similar episodes before or other family members with neurological conditions?

My symptoms started about a month ago, and they seem to worsen after physical activity but improve after a few hours of rest. I don't have numbness, tingling, or problems with speech or swallowing, but my upper limbs feel noticeably weaker when I do tasks like climbing stairs or brushing my hair. I haven’t had any recent infections or trauma, and I don’t have a family history of neurological disorders.
